_comment: AI GAME COMPANY license registry (master prompt section 8). Every AI model, asset, sound, texture and 3D model used by any game is registered here. Section 38: an entry with status UNKNOWN must never ship inside a released APK.
_rule_code_vs_weights: Section 8: an open-source CODE license does not imply the same license for MODEL WEIGHTS. The two are verified separately and get separate entries.

entries.name: Unity Engine and built-in modules
entries.source: Unity Technologies (installed locally, version pinned by ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt)
entries.redistribution_rules: Runtime redistributed inside the built APK, as the license intends. Editor is not redistributed.
entries.notes: Enabled built-in modules: androidjni, audio, particlesystem, physics2d, ui. Compliance with the user's Unity licence TIER (Personal vs Pro revenue thresholds) is the account holder's responsibility, not something this registry can verify.

entries.name: LegacyRuntime.ttf
entries.license: covered by the Unity Software License Agreement
entries.redistribution_rules: Ships inside the APK as a Unity built-in resource.
entries.notes: Currently the only font in the project. Any replacement font must get its own entry before shipping.

entries.name: Unlit/Color and Sprites/Default
entries.license: covered by the Unity Software License Agreement
entries.notes: Unlit is used deliberately because the generated scene contains no Light.

entries.name: Solid-colour placeholder sprites (ground, obstacle, coin, gravity zone)
entries.license: original work produced by this project
entries.notes: Placeholder art. Section 26 priority 6. Slated for replacement, which will need a new entry.

entries.name: Sine-tone jump / coin / game-over SFX
entries.source: generated at runtime by Assets/GameFactory/Core/ProceduralTone.cs via AudioClip.Create
entries.license: original work produced by this project
entries.notes: Section 28 priority 3 (procedural SFX). Placeholder standing in for real audio.

entries.name: MainCharacter placeholder mesh
entries.license: original work produced by this project, built from Unity primitive meshes
entries.notes: Section 38: this is a primitive placeholder, NOT a rigged humanoid character. It must never be reported as a finished 3D character.

entries.name: Hedgehog mascot reference images (15 files)
entries.notes: These are the visual basis for the shared main character across Game01-Game10, so this entry matters. They are currently SOURCE ONLY - nothing derived from them ships in any APK today (the shipped character is the primitive placeholder above). Before any derived model, texture or sprite goes into a release build, the user must confirm provenance: self-created, commissioned with commercial rights, or licensed. Section 38 forbids shipping UNKNOWN-licence assets. Section 43 and the standing instruction forbid deleting or replacing these source files.

pending_verification.candidateFor: Runner ground / obstacle / coin sprites - replaces the solid-colour placeholders that are currently the game's entire visual identity
pending_verification.reason: Secondary sources describe Kenney's asset packs as CC0 public domain with commercial use allowed and attribution not required. That is NOT sufficient under section 8. Claude Code cannot verify it directly: its container's egress proxy blocks kenney.nl, itch.io, opengameart.org and creativecommons.org.
pending_verification.verificationPlan: Run AI_GAME_COMPANY/tools/fetch-cc0-assets.ps1 on the PC. It downloads the archive, records its SHA-256, and commits the licence file shipped INSIDE the archive - the licence distributed with the exact bytes the game would use, which is stronger evidence than any web page. Status moves to APPROVED only after that captured text is read.

pending_verification.candidateFor: Parallax background layers. The game currently has no background at all beyond a flat camera clear colour, so this is the single largest visual gap.
pending_verification.reason: Same as above - unverified until the shipped licence file is captured.

Section 4: model IDs are not yet known - they come from HARDWARE_PROFILE.json ollamaApi.models once detect-environment.ps1 runs on the PC. Each specific model ID gets its own entry; 'it is a Qwen' or 'it is a DeepSeek' is explicitly NOT sufficient to assume a licence.
Section 9: FLUX.1-schnell is a candidate only. Its exact repository licence must be read before installation, and weights are licensed separately from any inference code.
Section 10: TripoSR or similar. Licence unverified, and section 38 forbids calling a raw mesh a finished humanoid character.
Section 10 Route B needs a base character with a licence permitting commercial use and modification. None selected yet.
